name: Logo Cloud
description: A 'Trusted by' logo strip that fades brand marks in from grayscale to full color on hover for tasteful, lightweight social proof.
usage: Import LogoCloud and drop it below a hero or above a footer: <LogoCloud eyebrow="Trusted by teams shipping on the coast" logos={[{ name: 'Tide & Co', src: '/logos/tide.svg', href: 'https://tideandco.example' }]} />. Pass your own logos array (name + svg/img src, optional href). For the no-React version, paste the markup from section.html and swap the inline SVGs for your brand marks.
